tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background — the interface's only "floor". Dark, slightly cool neutral. Everything else sits directly on it.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Fill of input fields, the switch track and the kana table details panel (decision 94). Not for cards: blocks are separated by spacing, not by fills.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of secondary and text buttons, list rows, menu items.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers (1px) and the chart grid. Decorative — carries no meaning, no contrast required.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Border of the secondary button, the switch track and learning kana in the kana table. 3.3:1 on bg, 3.0:1 on bg-raised.

tokens.name: fur
tokens.usage: The fur colour: main text, correctly typed kana, the kana of a learning task (introduction, recall), active elements, primary button fill. 13.8:1 on bg, 12.6:1 on bg-raised.

tokens.name: fur-bright
tokens.usage: Hover for fur-coloured elements (primary button fill, active link). Not for default text.

tokens.name: fur-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metric labels, live indicators, translation, inactive navigation and segment items, hints, placeholders, passed skip tokens, loading notices, the `click to focus` caption. 7.8:1 on bg, 7.1:1 on bg-raised, 6.4:1 on bg-hover.

tokens.name: fur-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled states only (text and knobs) and locked kana in the kana table. 2.8:1 on bg — deliberately below the threshold: what is inactive must not read as available.

tokens.name: untyped
tokens.usage: Kana not yet typed in the typing test's text stream, and the ghost hint in an introduction task (24px). Not for the recall kana: a question is fur. 3.4:1 on bg — only for text from 24px. Never below 24px (field placeholders use fur-dim).

tokens.name: on-fur
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a fur fill (primary button, tooltip). 13.8:1.

tokens.name: eye
tokens.usage: The only accent — the cat's eye colour: "where you are now". Caret, romaji buffer, counter, selection indicator (segments, track switch), focus, revealed romaji, personal best badge, mastered-kana mark, the cat's eyes. 9.5:1 on bg. Never fills an area larger than the caret or a switch knob. Not used for the due mark.

tokens.name: eye-bright
tokens.usage: Hover for eye-coloured elements (selected segment under the pointer).

tokens.name: miss
tokens.usage: Error or a blocked action only: mistyped kana, caret flash on a rejected key, field error text, load errors, wrong option, danger button. A muted, calm red. 6.1:1 on bg, 5.5:1 on bg-raised.

tokens.name: miss-dim
tokens.usage: Underline of a mistyped kana and a wrong option. Not for text: 2.7:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: solid 2px outline with a 2px offset. 9.5:1 on bg, 8.6:1 on bg-raised.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection background (::selection) — eye at 20% opacity.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Page dimming under a dialog — bg at 80% opacity.

tokens.name: chart-kpm
tokens.usage: The line of every /stats chart (2px): KPM per test and the daily median answer time; points on the answer-time chart. Keeps its v9 name (decision 69). Charts never appear on /.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Horizontal chart grid lines, 1px. The target answer time line uses line-strong, dashed.

tokens.name: chart-cursor
tokens.usage: Vertical cursor line when hovering the chart.

tokens.name: heat-fur-1
tokens.usage: Step 1/5 of the fur scale. Not used in the MVP (reaction-time heatmap is out, ADR 058).

tokens.name: heat-fur-2
tokens.usage: Step 2/5 of the fur scale. Not used in the MVP (reaction-time heatmap is out, ADR 058).

tokens.name: heat-fur-3
tokens.usage: Kana table, state mode: fill of confident kana; kana in fur — 5.28:1, fill vs bg 2.62:1. (Step 3/5 of the fur scale; its heatmap use is not in the MVP.)

tokens.name: heat-fur-4
tokens.usage: Kana table, state mode: fill of mastered kana; kana in on-fur — 6.10:1, plus the eye mark below. (Step 4/5 of the fur scale; its heatmap use is not in the MVP.)

tokens.name: heat-fur-5
tokens.usage: Step 5/5 of the fur scale. Not used in the MVP (reaction-time heatmap is out, ADR 058).

tokens.name: heat-miss-1
tokens.usage: Step 1/5 of the error scale. Not used in the MVP (ADR 058: heatmaps are out).

tokens.name: heat-miss-2
tokens.usage: Step 2/5 of the error scale. Not used in the MVP (ADR 058: heatmaps are out).

tokens.name: heat-miss-3
tokens.usage: Step 3/5 of the error scale. Not used in the MVP (ADR 058: heatmaps are out).

tokens.name: heat-miss-4
tokens.usage: Step 4/5 of the error scale. Not used in the MVP (ADR 058: heatmaps are out).

tokens.name: heat-miss-5
tokens.usage: Step 5/5 of the error scale. Not used in the MVP (ADR 058: heatmaps are out).

tokens.name: cat-fur
tokens.usage: The cat's fur: line, geometry, silhouette.

tokens.name: cat-eye
tokens.usage: The cat's eyes — the only colour spot in the drawing.

tokens.name: cat-ground
tokens.usage: Cut-outs inside the cat (pupils, closed eyes, the gap between head and body). The cat always stands on bg.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", "Noto Sans JP", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
families.ui: "Golos Text", "Noto Sans JP", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

groups.name: Japanese
groups.note: Kana is the hero of the screen. One weight (400). Production subset (ADR 032, 034): every kana of the table, every glyph of the words and phrases, plus ーっッゃゅょャュョァィゥェォ、。・０–９ — no kanji, no ！？. The font changes in one place: type.families.jp.

styles.name: jp-solo
styles.sample: か き く け こ さ
styles.usage: Kana of a learning task on desktop: introduction and recall (ADR 058: the typing test has no kana mode any more).

styles.name: jp-solo-sm
styles.sample: か き く け こ
styles.usage: Kana of a learning task below 640px (introduction, recall) — sized to fit above the on-screen keyboard.

styles.name: jp-test
styles.sample: しずかな よる に ねこ が
styles.usage: The typing test's words and phrases on desktop: up to 3 lines visible at once.

styles.name: jp-test-sm
styles.sample: しずかな よる に
styles.usage: The typing test's words and phrases below 640px: ≈ 9 characters per line at 360px, 2 lines visible.

styles.name: jp-cell
styles.usage: Single kana in a kana table cell (state mode on /), in the activation details, and in the session summary lists (unlocked, now confident).

styles.name: jp-cell-sm
styles.usage: Two-character kana in a 44px cell: combinations (きゃ) and extended katakana rows (ティ).

styles.name: jp-body
styles.sample: まど を みて いる
styles.usage: Kana inside the interface: mixups, the session summary rows (faster, slower, confused), row options, history.

styles.name: jp-vertical
styles.usage: Not used in the MVP (decision 85): the vertical mode label is replaced by the mode line from i18n. Kept for the record: kana, ・ and ０–９ only.

groups.name: Romaji and numbers
groups.note: Everything that is typed or counted. Weights 400 and 500. Subset: U+0020–007E, Cyrillic А–я, Ёё, ← → ✕. No · — the separator in mono text falls back to the system font.

styles.name: mono-hero
styles.usage: One large number or prompt per screen: KPM on the typing results screen; the romaji prompt of a recognition task (`nu`).

styles.name: mono-hero-sm
styles.usage: mono-hero below 640px: KPM on results, the recognition prompt above the on-screen keyboard.

styles.name: mono-stat
styles.usage: Secondary metrics: kana accuracy and time on typing results; current and best streak on /stats. (IPM and best in-test streak are out of the MVP.)

styles.name: mono-counter
styles.usage: Typing test counter (number in eye, unit in fur-dim): time 42 s, count 7 / 25, zen finished prompts; the romaji ghost hint in an introduction task (untyped).

styles.name: mono-romaji
styles.usage: Romaji buffer under the caret (stream, recall), the revealed romaji, romaji next to kana in the table details, numbers inside labels (mastered 7 of 104), answer times in the session summary (1720 → 1380).

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: Live indicators in a typing test, the learning session line (learning · 7 of 25 / обучение · 7 из 25), chart axis labels, keys (Kbd), table row headers; the recall buffer below 640px.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Golos Text 400 and 500. Subset: the same Latin and Cyrillic plus ū ō é ← → · … — – « » × №. Slightly narrower than Inter — Russian labels fit without wrapping. No curly quotes: use « » in Russian and " in English.

styles.name: ui-title
styles.usage: Screen title (settings, profile, stats). One per screen.

styles.name: ui-caption
styles.usage: Metric labels, hints under fields, tooltips.

spacing.note: 4px step. Screen structure is built with spacing, not borders: space-12 and more between groups.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between segments of one group; between a number and its unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside the tooltip; label → metric value; size of the due mark on a kana cell.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of fields and small buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button padding; side page margin on a phone; icon size next to a button label.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups in the config bar; between metrics in a row; padding of lg buttons.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Side page margin on desktop; between settings rows; air around the stream on a phone.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Config bar → typing area; sections of the results screen.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Navigation → content.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Vertical air around the text stream on desktop.

radius.note: Nearly square corners. The ceiling is 6px; anything rounder is not part of the system.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Dividers, charts, the cat.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Caret, selected-segment indicator, switch knob, chart marks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, tooltip, switch track.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Pop-up menus and dialogs — the system's maximum.

stroke.note: Two line weights in the interface plus the cat's line.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Dividers, borders of secondary controls, chart grid.

tokens.name: stroke-mark
tokens.usage: Caret, selection indicator, mastered-kana mark, focus ring, KPM line.

tokens.name: stroke-cat
tokens.usage: Line weight of the cat in the "line" style, in viewBox 96 units (≈2.5% of the height). Does not scale separately from the drawing.

tokens.name: layout-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of content and navigation.

tokens.name: layout-test
tokens.usage: Text stream line width: ~18 jp-test characters.

tokens.name: layout-nav-h
tokens.usage: Navigation height.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of buttons and fields (md).

tokens.name: control-h-sm
tokens.usage: Height of small buttons and segments; the reserved notice line of a learning task.

tokens.name: caret-h
tokens.usage: Caret height relative to the kana size.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target under pointer: coarse — height of buttons, segments, navigation links, the learning session line; size of kana table cells. Recognition options are 56px tall below 640px.

tokens.name: bp-narrow
tokens.usage: The width below which *-sm styles, 2 stream lines and a column instead of a row turn on. Used in @media (max-width: 639px).

tokens.name: test-lines
tokens.usage: Visible stream lines on desktop.

tokens.name: test-lines-sm
tokens.usage: Visible stream lines on a narrow screen — the on-screen keyboard takes the rest.

duration.note: Micro-animations only, and only transform / opacity. A character's colour changes instantly. Nothing longer than 320ms except the caret blink.

tokens.name: dur-caret
tokens.usage: Caret moving to the next character.

tokens.name: dur-reject
tokens.usage: Caret flash in miss on a rejected key (typing test, recall, introduction): a separate layer, opacity only.

tokens.name: dur-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and focus: colour, fill; tooltip; Restart and the `click to focus` caption appearing.

tokens.name: dur-fade
tokens.usage: Typing test chrome (navigation, config bar, footer, the slot above the stream) leaves on the first keystroke and returns on mouse movement or after the test.

tokens.name: dur-reveal
tokens.usage: A block appearing on the results screen (fade + 4px rise).

tokens.name: dur-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between adjacent result blocks.

tokens.name: dur-draw
tokens.usage: Drawing in the chart line on /stats only.

tokens.name: dur-blink
tokens.usage: Caret blink period when the user has not typed for > 1 s. Not used for loading text (static by decision).

easing.note: No springs or bounces: only curves without overshoot.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default: caret, appearance, hover.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: The interface leaving at the start of a test, the tooltip disappearing.

tokens.name: ease-inout
tokens.usage: Caret blink.
